summary: Sedona, Arizona, independent software consultant, master's degree in computer science, expertise in Ruby, Common Lisp, Java, and web development, strong preference for organic and locally grown food, enjoys hiking and cooking, married with a grandson, has a Myers Parrot, anti-Microsoft views, advocates for financial prudence and living without credit, active in cloud computing (AWS, Google AppEngine), author of technical books, interested in semantic web technologies, follows technical blogs and uses Twitter for information, prefers working from home, values self-contained projects, enjoys playing Go, and has experience in game development and virtual reality.
